WITH online AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pc_id FROM pc_monitor.metrics_history
  WHERE collected_at > now() - interval '5 minutes'
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pc_id FROM pc_monitor.anomaly_history
  WHERE detected_at > now() - interval '30 minutes' AND severity IN ('MEDIUM','HIGH')
)
SELECT COALESCE(round(100.0 *
  (SELECT count(*) FROM online WHERE pc_id NOT IN (SELECT pc_id FROM flagged))
  / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM online), 0), 1), 0) AS value

WITH t AS (SELECT generate_series(now() - interval '28 min', now(), interval '4 min') AS ts)
SELECT ts, (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT a.pc_id) FROM pc_monitor.anomaly_history a
  WHERE a.detected_at > ts - interval '30 minutes' AND a.detected_at <= ts
    AND (a.anomaly_type ILIKE '%MINING%' OR a.message ILIKE '%mining%' OR a.alerts::text ILIKE '%MINING%')
) AS value
FROM t ORDER BY ts

WITH t AS (SELECT generate_series(now() - interval '28 min', now(), interval '4 min') AS ts)
SELECT ts, (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT a.pc_id) FROM pc_monitor.anomaly_history a
  WHERE a.detected_at > ts - interval '30 minutes' AND a.detected_at <= ts
    AND a.severity IN ('LOW','MEDIUM')
) AS value
FROM t ORDER BY ts

WITH t AS (SELECT generate_series(now() - interval '28 min', now(), interval '4 min') AS ts)
SELECT ts, (SELECT count(*) FROM pc_monitor.pc_info WHERE pc_id ~ '^PC-[0-9]+$') - (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT m.pc_id) FROM pc_monitor.metrics_history m
  WHERE m.collected_at > ts - interval '5 minutes' AND m.collected_at <= ts
    AND m.pc_id ~ '^PC-[0-9]+$'
) AS value
FROM t ORDER BY ts

WITH t AS (
  SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('day', now()), now(), interval '2 hour') AS ts
  UNION SELECT now()
)
SELECT ts, COALESCE((
  SELECT round(avg((a.scores->>'final')::numeric), 1) FROM pc_monitor.anomaly_history a
  WHERE a.detected_at >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND a.detected_at <= ts
), 0) AS value
FROM t ORDER BY ts

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.pc_id)
         m.pc_id,
         m.collected_at,
         m.cpu_percent  AS cpu,
         m.gpu_percent  AS gpu,
         m.mem_percent  AS mem,
         pc.hostname
  FROM pc_monitor.metrics_history m
  LEFT JOIN pc_monitor.pc_info pc ON pc.pc_id = m.pc_id
  WHERE m.collected_at > now() - interval '5 minutes'
  ORDER BY m.pc_id, m.collected_at DESC
),
scores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.pc_id)
         a.pc_id,
         (a.scores->>'final')::float       AS score,
         a.severity                          AS severity_raw
  FROM pc_monitor.anomaly_history a
  WHERE a.detected_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
  ORDER BY a.pc_id, a.detected_at DESC
)
SELECT
  l.pc_id,
  l.hostname,
  COALESCE(l.cpu, 0)::float AS cpu,
  COALESCE(l.gpu, 0)::float AS gpu,
  COALESCE(l.mem, 0)::float AS mem,
  COALESCE(s.score, 0)::float AS score,
  CASE
    WHEN l.collected_at IS NULL OR l.collected_at < now() - interval '5 minutes' THEN -1
    WHEN s.severity_raw = 'HIGH'   THEN 3
    WHEN s.severity_raw = 'MEDIUM' THEN 2
    ELSE 0
  END::int AS severity
FROM latest l
LEFT JOIN scores s ON s.pc_id = l.pc_id
ORDER BY l.pc_id

SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.pc_id)
  a.pc_id, a.severity,
  COALESCE(a.anomaly_type, '') AS type,
  COALESCE(a.message, '') AS description,
  (a.scores->>'final')::float AS score,
  round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - a.detected_at)) / 60)::int AS minutes_ago
FROM pc_monitor.anomaly_history a
WHERE a.detected_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
ORDER BY a.pc_id, a.detected_at DESC

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN upper(COALESCE(judgment, verdict, 'NORMAL')) IN ('DANGEROUS','HIGH_RISK') THEN 'DANGEROUS'
    WHEN upper(COALESCE(details->>'hw_degradation', 'NONE')) IN ('SUSPECTED','CONFIRMED') THEN '기타'
    WHEN upper(COALESCE(judgment, verdict, 'NORMAL')) = 'SUSPICIOUS' THEN 'SUSPICIOUS'
    WHEN upper(COALESCE(judgment, verdict, 'NORMAL')) = 'NORMAL' THEN 'NORMAL'
    ELSE '기타'
  END AS verdict,
  count(*) AS count,
  CASE
    WHEN upper(COALESCE(judgment, verdict, 'NORMAL')) IN ('DANGEROUS','HIGH_RISK') THEN '#f43f5e'
    WHEN upper(COALESCE(details->>'hw_degradation', 'NONE')) IN ('SUSPECTED','CONFIRMED') THEN '#3b82f6'
    WHEN upper(COALESCE(judgment, verdict, 'NORMAL')) = 'SUSPICIOUS' THEN '#fbbf24'
    WHEN upper(COALESCE(judgment, verdict, 'NORMAL')) = 'NORMAL' THEN '#00b574'
    ELSE '#3b82f6'
  END AS color
FROM pc_monitor.ai_judgment_history
WHERE judged_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT
  a.pc_id, a.severity,
  COALESCE(a.anomaly_type, '') AS type,
  COALESCE(a.message, '') AS description,
  (a.scores->>'final')::float AS score,
  round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - a.detected_at)) / 60)::int AS minutes_ago
FROM pc_monitor.anomaly_history a
WHERE a.detected_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
ORDER BY a.detected_at DESC
LIMIT 12

SELECT
  round(avg(cpu_percent)::numeric, 1) AS cpu,
  round(avg(gpu_percent)::numeric, 1) AS gpu,
  round(avg(mem_percent)::numeric, 1) AS mem,
  count(DISTINCT pc_id)::int AS n_pcs
FROM pc_monitor.metrics_history
WHERE collected_at > now() - interval '5 minutes'
